products.title: 2-1/2" Glycerin-Filled Pressure Gauge, Stainless Case, 1/4" Bottom Mount
products.focusKeyword: glycerin filled pressure gauge bottom (lower) mount
products.descriptionShort: 2-1/2" Glycerin-Filled Pressure Gauge, Stainless Case, 1/4" Bottom Mount: brass internals, ASME B40.100, 28 ranges from vacuum, compound and 0–15 psi up to 0–15,000 psi.
products.descriptionLong:
A 2-1/2" dial pressure gauge with a stainless steel case and bezel and copper-alloy (brass) internals, filled with glycerin to damp pointer flutter from pump pulsation and vibration. Stem-mounted on the line or manifold, connection underneath.

Specification

  • Dial: 2-1/2", dual scale psi and bar
  • Case and bezel: stainless steel
  • Internals: copper alloy (brass) Bourdon tube and socket
  • Lens: polycarbonate
  • Fill: glycerin
  • Connection: 1/4", bottom (lower) mount
  • Standard: ASME B40.100

Ranges

28 ranges, vacuum, compound and 0–15 psi up to 0–15,000 psi. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every scale.

Choosing a range

Pick a scale whose full reading is about twice the normal working pressure, so the pointer sits mid-dial and spikes stay on the scale. Brass internals suit oil, water and air; for corrosive media ask for a stainless-internal gauge.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the range, mounting and connection thread. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.question: Why is it glycerin filled?
faqs.answer: The fill damps the pointer against pulsation and vibration and lubricates the movement, so the reading stays steady and the gauge lasts longer.

faqs.question: What media can it measure?
faqs.answer: Media compatible with brass internals: hydraulic oil, water and air. Ask for a stainless-internal gauge for corrosive media.

faqs.question: What thread is the connection?
faqs.answer: A 1/4" connection. Tell us the thread your port needs and we will confirm it with the quotation.

faqs.question: What is the lead time?
faqs.answer: Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
